cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Lend Me the Edge
cards.instruction: Get someone to provide the one advantage you need without making the eventual success feel borrowed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I left my oven door open like yours. My cake's still liquid; tell me the temperature that wins this competition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine was cooling. You have to close the oven to bake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, the closed-door stage. What setting should I use for my recipe?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll set it for you, but tell the judges I helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just tell me the number; I'll turn the dial. Your name doesn't need to go on my entry.
